paragraphs: (The [father of the prophet Jeremiah](https://www.sefaria.org/Jeremiah.1.1).) Rabbi Yitzchak bar Chilkiyah: [Vayikra Rabbah 30:3](https://www.sefaria.org/Vayikra_Rabbah.30.3). Rav Minyomi bar Chilkiyah: [Yoma 2a](https://www.sefaria.org/Yoma.2a.8).[^1][^2]

notes.text: Yoma has Rav Minyomi bar Chilkiyah speaking in Rabbi Machasya bar Idi’s name, in Rabbi Yochanan’s name. [Heilprin’s Minyomi entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2503&lang=en) records that chain and discusses the folio and chronology.
The linked Vayikra Rabbah names Rabbi Yitzchak be-Rabbi Chilkiyah. Jeremiah 1:1 separately names Jeremiah son of Chilkiyah. Hyman lists these notices under a shared headword.
